stacking_rules.text: 232 (autos/parts/vehicles/MHDV/metals/wood/semiconductors/pharma/UAS) and 301-FL are mutually exclusive. 232 wins via 9903.05.90. Exceptions that do not suppress FL: 9903.08.20 (not for UAS use); 9903.94.06 when claimed as not a PV/LT part (Note 52(f)(3) covers .06 only for USMCA-eligible parts); 9903.74.11 alone (not in Note 52(f)(6)).

China 301 (legacy 9903.88.xx and four-year review 9903.91.xx / 9903.92.10) is NOT suppressed by 232 or Sec 122. Reports in the Section 301 slot before 338/232 (CSMS #69668138). Within Section 301, heading order is not prescribed. Note 31 replaces 9903.88.xx on the same HTS.
Section 122 does NOT stack with Section 232. Report 9903.03.06; suppress 9903.03.01.
Brazil Section 301 (9903.05.01 @ 25%, eff. 2026-07-22) stacks with 301-FL Brazil (9903.05.27 @ 12.5%). 232 universe uses exemption 9903.05.07 and still suppresses FL via 9903.05.90.
232 automobiles are origin-driven. JP/EU/KR combined-cap headings when col-1 is under 15%; Ch.1–97 line zeroed for that path. Default other origins: 9903.94.01 / .05 @ 25% additional.
9903.82.02 — primary metal articles: +50% on metal-content value.
9903.82.09 — copper / derivative alu+steel: +25% on entered value.
Sec 122 is entry-level — 9903.03.01 on any ESL of an Entry Summary Number satisfies the entry.
232 metals vs 232 autos on Ch.73/74 — TBC.
Trade-deal MFN cap mechanic unresolved — block totals for leftover 9903.94.45/.55 and trade_deal_* flags. JP/EU/KR CSMS origin splits compute under R3.
9903.94.xx program labeling (232 autos vs trade-deal) — TBC (legal basis / drawback).
HTS authority: Item Master for parts; HA30 for vehicles with Item Master fallback.
AD/CVD outside Ch.99 stack — flag only; do not invent case rates.
SPI S/S+ / CAFTA-DR zeros Column 1 + MPF only. Does not clear 301-FL, 232, China 301, Brazil 301, or Section 338.
Section 338 Canada 9903.03.12–.14 @ 50% from 2026-08-22. Note 51(c) → 9903.03.15 when 232-family applies (incl. UAS 9903.08.20–.26). Aircraft .16 needs GN6. Reports after 301, before 232.
Section 201 QSP TRQ (9903.45.30 in-quota / 9903.45.31 over-quota) auto-applies on 6810.99.0020 / .0040 / 7020.00.6000 from 2026-08-15. Stacks with 301-FL. Default in-quota.

Chapter 98: general 98xx suppresses China 301 / 301-FL / Brazil 301 / 338; 9802.00.40/.50 repair-value basis; 9802.00.60 keeps 232 on entered value; 9802.00.80 assembly less US content. Reports first on 7501.
